about_the_game:
Welcome to the cats adventure game page. Currently, this game is still under development and is expected to be released in the first half of 2025.

A group of cat residents live in a seaside town, and a group of cats named "Abyssal Predators" betray their home due to greed and attempt to control the ocean. Young Cat Wave Shadow, unite with Cat Warriors to fight against Abyssal Predators.

By defeating monsters in the game, players can level up and earn coins, which can be used to purchase skills and weapons to become stronger. As the game progresses, you can unlock more cat heroes and experience more fun.

name: 超级猫幸存者: 死或喵 Demo
short_description: This is a turn-based game that emphasizes both strategy and fun. You will command various charming cat heroes to fight against the surging army of monsters. In the battle, you can choose from a variety of weapons, and every precise strike brings ultimate pleasure.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean, Traditional Chinese
